## Progress

- Dev environment for India as code in `infra/bicep/main.bicep` (single file), deployed to resource group rg-medvya-dev-in in Central India: App Service (F1), Azure SQL free offer with Entra-only auth, Storage, Key Vault (RBAC, purge protection), Log Analytics + Application Insights with a daily cap, a 1,800 INR monthly budget with 50/80/100 % alerts, and an allowed-locations policy
- Left (shortcut, cost): private endpoints and SQL public access disabled, Defender plans, staging slot and VNet integration; staging and prod parameter files; deploy from CI (MDV-P0-007)

## Description

infra/bicep/main.bicep (+ postgres.bicep) for the India dev environment, which is the pilot target. Staging and production parameters, the staging slot, Defender plans and a Storage private endpoint move to MDV-P1-039 (decided 13 Nov 2026). App Service (Linux, .NET 10) with VNet integration; Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with Entra-only auth, private access (VNet-integrated), public network access disabled; Storage with private endpoint and no public blob access; Key Vault with RBAC, soft delete and purge protection; Application Insights + Log Analytics; Defender for Cloud plans; budgets and cost alerts per environment; Azure Policy denying resources outside the allowed region(s).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** `az deployment group what-if` and, after a reviewer approves, a real deployment of dev succeed from CI (`infra-dev` workflow) with no manual portal steps.
- [ ] **AC2.** The PostgreSQL server `publicNetworkAccess` is Disabled and only reachable from the VNet (verified by a connectivity test from outside the VNet failing).
- [ ] **AC3.** Key Vault has purge protection enabled; Storage has `allowBlobPublicAccess=false`.
- [ ] **AC4.** A budget with email alerts at 50/80/100 % exists for the dev environment.
- [ ] **AC5.** Azure Policy assignment denies creating resources in any region other than the configured country region(s).
- [ ] **AC6.** No secret value appears in any Bicep or parameter file.
